conflicts_resolved: Island intro line: planner_couple (primary, weight 0.4) praised it; funding_parent, sceptic and search_visitor called it a mood line. The editor has already made it plainer ('reef' removed), and the card below states the plain facts, so the line stays. The primary persona and the brief's dreaming-stage reader win.

Card detail: planner_couple, sceptic, search_visitor and uhnw want venue, date, guest count or cost; the brief allows only what each story states and bars venue names. Brief wins; only the vague 'glamorous reception' is swapped for a stated fact (p03).
Fee and commissions: sceptic wants commission and itemised-price prompts; the orchestrator rejected them and brand-facts gives no fee model. No change; deferred.

Scale and privacy: uhnw wants scale proof, security and private arrivals; the brief's reader is a couple in their 30s. Only venue questions (whole stay, arrivals kept from the public) and a privacy invitation in the close were added; nothing is promised.

Sun section: search_visitor and uhnw also found the shade sentence long, but the primary persona said the venue questions under it are useful. Only the how-to sentence (fact_09) is cut; UV, shade and the questions stay, so the page keeps its sourced detail.
Takeaway 1: the brief framed it as 'every wedding comes from our own published stories'; search_visitor wants the settings. Both kept in one sentence.
